description: Two function references that do NOT fire E-ERROR-002 under the S441 reference rule. `<formFor onsubmit=persistSignup/>` passes a failable function by reference, but its compiler-generated submit dispatch is the §19.6.6 / §41.14.3 route to the nearest `<errorBoundary>`, not an author-written handler. An `<each in=@fns as risky>` row's `onclick=risky` names the row alias, a local binding that shadows the file's failable `risky`.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S441 "yes on references" (formFor exempt, per the ruled question); S440 22-item queue #19
rationale: §19.4.3 — the reference rule covers a reference to a `!` function resolved through scope; the `<formFor>` `onsubmit=` reference is governed by §41.14.3 and §19.6.6 instead.
